name: Generic OIDC
description: Connect any OIDC-compatible identity provider — Authentik, Ory, Okta, Auth0, Azure AD, and more.
longDescription:
## Generic OIDC Identity Provider

Connect Kleff to any identity provider that supports OpenID Connect.

### Compatible providers
- **Authentik** — set issuer to your application's OIDC provider URL
- **Ory Hydra / Kratos** — set issuer to your Hydra issuer URL
- **Okta** — set issuer to `https://your-org.okta.com/oauth2/default`
- **Auth0** — set issuer to `https://your-tenant.auth0.com/`
- **Azure AD** — set issuer to `https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/v2.0`
- **Google** — set issuer to `https://accounts.google.com`
- Any other OIDC-compliant provider

### Login modes
- **redirect** *(recommended)* — users are sent to your IDP's login page. Works with every provider.
- **headless** — Kleff shows its own login form and forwards credentials via Resource Owner Password Credentials (ROPC). Only enable if your provider supports the ROPC grant.

### User registration
This plugin does not create users — manage accounts through your identity provider's admin interface.

### Setup
1. Create an OIDC application / client in your identity provider.
2. Set the redirect URI to `https://your-kleff-domain/auth/callback`.
3. Copy the issuer URL, client ID, and client secret below.
author: Kleff

config.label: Issuer URL
config.description: Your identity provider's OIDC issuer URL. The plugin fetches configuration from {issuer}/.well-known/openid-configuration.

config.label: Client ID
config.description: The client ID of your OIDC application.

config.label: Client Secret
config.description: The client secret. Leave blank for public clients.

config.label: Login Mode
config.description: redirect — users log in via your IDP's own login page (recommended). headless — Kleff shows its own form and forwards credentials via ROPC (only enable if your IDP supports it).

name: Component Showcase
description: UI primitives and domain component showcase. Adds a Components page and sidebar nav item.
longDescription:
## Component Showcase

Adds a **Components** page (`/p/components`) to the Kleff panel and a matching sidebar nav item.

Showcases all Kleff UI primitives and domain components — buttons, badges, cards, charts, toasts, and more — useful for plugin development and design review.
author: Kleff

name: Keycloak
description: Red Hat Keycloak identity provider. SSO, MFA, and self-hosted user management.
longDescription:
## Keycloak Identity Provider

Kleff deploys and manages a Keycloak container automatically. No configuration required.

### Features
- Bundled Keycloak container (no external setup needed)
- SSO and MFA via Keycloak
- User registration via Keycloak Admin REST API
- RS256 JWT verification via JWKS endpoint

### Setup
Click Install & Activate. Kleff will start Keycloak, configure the realm, and set up an admin user automatically.
author: Kleff

config.label: Login Mode
config.description: redirect — users log in via Keycloak's own login page (recommended). headless — Kleff shows its own form and forwards credentials via ROPC.

config.label: Keycloak Public URL
config.description: Browser-reachable URL for Keycloak. Required for redirect login mode. Defaults to http://localhost:8180 (the port Keycloak is exposed on).

name: Loki
description: Log aggregation backend. Receives workload logs from the platform via gRPC and stores them in Grafana Loki.
longDescription:
Deploys a gRPC wrapper alongside a Loki container. The platform forwards workload log entries via IngestLog gRPC calls; the wrapper writes them to Loki using the Loki push API.

Exposes a LogQL-compatible query endpoint at http://loki:3100 for Grafana and other visualizers.
author: Kleff

config.label: Loki URL
config.description: Override to use an external Loki instance. Leave blank to use the bundled companion.

name: Tempo
description: Distributed tracing backend. Receives trace spans from the platform via gRPC and stores them in Grafana Tempo.
longDescription:
Deploys a gRPC wrapper alongside a Tempo container. The platform forwards trace spans via IngestSpan gRPC calls; the wrapper writes them to Tempo using the Zipkin push API.

Exposes a TraceQL-compatible query endpoint at http://tempo:3200 for Grafana and other visualizers.
author: Kleff

config.label: Tempo Zipkin URL
config.description: Override to use an external Tempo instance (Zipkin endpoint). Leave blank to use the bundled companion.

name: VictoriaMetrics
description: Time-series metrics backend. Receives workload metrics from the platform via gRPC and stores them in VictoriaMetrics.
longDescription:
Deploys a gRPC wrapper alongside a VictoriaMetrics container. The platform forwards workload metric samples via IngestMetrics gRPC calls; the wrapper writes them to VictoriaMetrics using the Prometheus import API.

Exposes a PromQL-compatible query endpoint at http://victoriametrics:8428 for Grafana and other visualizers.
author: Kleff

config.label: VictoriaMetrics URL
config.description: Override to use an external VictoriaMetrics instance. Leave blank to use the bundled companion.

name: Alertmanager
description: Prometheus Alertmanager — routes, deduplicates, and silences alerts from Prometheus-compatible sources.
longDescription:
Deploys the official Prometheus Alertmanager. Receives alerts from Alloy or Prometheus-compatible collectors and routes them to configured receivers (Slack, PagerDuty, email, webhooks).

Access the Alertmanager UI at http://localhost:9093.
author: Kleff

config.label: Platform URL
config.description: Internal URL of the Kleff platform API. Auto-injected by the platform — only override if Alertmanager is not on the same Docker network.

name: Grafana Alloy
description: Grafana Alloy — a flexible, high-performance telemetry collector for metrics, logs, and traces.
longDescription:
Deploys Grafana Alloy as the central telemetry collector. Alloy discovers scrape targets via the platform HTTP SD API, collects Prometheus metrics, and forwards them to the active monitoring.metrics backend (e.g. VictoriaMetrics).

Alloy configuration is auto-generated from the platform's plugin discovery API at the KLEFF_PLATFORM_URL.
author: Kleff

config.label: Platform URL
config.description: Internal URL of the Kleff platform API. Auto-injected by the platform — only override if Alloy is not on the same Docker network.

name: Grafana
description: Grafana dashboards pre-configured for Kleff observability plugins — visualize logs, traces, and metrics in one place.
longDescription:
Deploys Grafana with pre-provisioned datasources and dashboards for the Kleff observability stack.

Automatically connects to the active monitoring.logs (Loki), monitoring.traces (Tempo), and monitoring.metrics (VictoriaMetrics or InfluxDB) backends.

Access the Grafana UI at http://localhost:3000.
author: Kleff

name: cAdvisor
description: Exports per-container resource usage metrics (CPU, memory, network, disk) for Prometheus scraping.
longDescription: Runs Google cAdvisor alongside the Docker daemon to collect per-container CPU, memory, network, and filesystem metrics. Exposes them in Prometheus text format. Automatically discovered as a scrape target by the platform HTTP SD endpoint.
author: Kleff

name: InfluxDB
description: Time-series metrics backend. Stores metrics from Alloy via Prometheus remote write.
longDescription: Deploys InfluxDB 3 Core as a time-series metrics backend. Alloy writes metrics via the Prometheus remote write endpoint. Query data using InfluxQL or SQL in the InfluxDB UI at http://localhost:8181.
author: Kleff

config.label: Database
config.description: InfluxDB database name. Created automatically on first write.

config.label: Admin Token
config.description: InfluxDB admin token used by Alloy to write metrics. Set this to a strong secret.

config.label: External InfluxDB URL
config.description: Override to use an external InfluxDB 3 instance. Leave blank to use the bundled companion.

name: Node Exporter
description: Exposes host-level hardware and OS metrics for Prometheus/Alloy scraping.
longDescription: Runs the official Prometheus node_exporter on each host. Exports CPU, memory, disk, filesystem, network, and load metrics in Prometheus text format. Alloy or any Prometheus-compatible collector will automatically discover this plugin as a scrape target via the platform HTTP SD endpoint.
author: Kleff

name: Slack Notifications
description: Routes Alertmanager alerts to a Slack channel via an incoming webhook.
longDescription:
Registers a Slack incoming webhook URL with the platform so that Alertmanager (or any alerting plugin) can deliver alert notifications to your Slack workspace.

No container is deployed — the webhook URL is stored securely and injected into Alertmanager configuration at runtime.
author: Kleff

config.label: Slack Incoming Webhook URL
config.description: The Slack incoming webhook URL, e.g. https://hooks.slack.com/services/T.../B.../... — the channel is set when you create the webhook in Slack.
